name: Object Storage
description: File and object storage through the kernel (local, S3/Garage, etc.). Plugins never touch the host filesystem.

capabilities.name: Read
capabilities.description: Read or download objects from configured storage backends.

capabilities.name: Write
capabilities.description: Upload or write objects to configured storage backends.

capabilities.name: Delete
capabilities.description: Delete objects from configured storage backends.

capabilities.name: List
capabilities.description: List objects under a prefix in a storage backend.
